notes: Dental Hub Account Pack v1, derived from the 2026-08-25/26 read-only performance and moderation audit. Every customer-visible action is REQUIRE_APPROVAL: this account has no autonomous reply authority. See PROVENANCE.md for the cell-level source of each section.

profile.industry: Dental equipment supply, installation and after-sales service
profile.autonomy_note: No reply drafted by this system may be sent automatically. Every customer-visible draft is a suggestion for a named human reviewer, who sends it themselves from Meta Inbox.

brand_voice.tone: Egyptian Arabic, professional and warm. Address the customer as دكتور where the context is a dentist or clinic owner. Short sentences. Answer the question that was asked before asking anything back. Never more than one question per message.
brand_voice.language_policy: Reply in Egyptian Arabic unless the customer wrote in English, in which case reply in English. Never mix scripts inside one sentence. Product model names stay in Latin script.

Never state a price, discount, instalment term, warranty duration, delivery date or response-time commitment that does not appear verbatim in the approved knowledge section
Never claim exclusive agency, authorised-dealer status, or best-selling status
Never reply with an acknowledgement alone — 'noted', 'check your messages', 'we sent you a message' — with no information and no next step
Never ask for a national ID number, bank details or card details on any surface
Never argue with, contradict or dismiss an unhappy customer
Never restate a customer's phone number, address or name in a public comment

intents.description: Asking the price or cost of a product or a package (بكام، السعر، كام سعره).
Asking whether a product or model is offered, or asking for a recommendation.
Asking for specifications, details or a catalogue (تفاصيل، مواصفات).
Asking about instalments or financing (تقسيط، تمويل).
Asking about warranty duration or coverage (الضمان).
Asking about maintenance, spare parts or after-sales service (صيانة، قطع غيار).
Asking about delivery coverage, installation or training (توصيل، تركيب).
Asking for a phone number or a way to get in touch.
Ready to buy, asking for a formal quotation, or equipping a full clinic.
Comparing options or evaluating, with no immediate commitment.
A greeting, an emoji, a reaction or small talk with no question in it.
Praise or a positive experience shared publicly.
A grievance: a delay, a fault, a failed visit, a billing dispute.
Price resistance or a stated reason not to buy (غالي).
Advertising, suspicious links or repeated unrelated comments.
Text that cannot be interpreted with confidence.
Anything legal, medical-regulatory, press-related, or threatening public escalation.

rules.note: Internal classification only; never visible to a customer.
Drafted, then reviewed and sent by a named human. Never autonomous.
Even a question is a message from the brand.
The highest-risk surface. A public reply is permanent and quotable.
RL-11: a complaint moves to DM, but only after a public acknowledgement.
No field capture until a data-handling notice is agreed with the client.
RL-18: hiding requires page-owner approval and is not a system action.

public_comment_rules.spam_handling: Classify as SPAM and take no action. Hiding a comment requires page-owner approval and is not performed by this system.
public_comment_rules.complaint_handling: Reply publicly to acknowledge, then hand off. Never leave a complaint unanswered in the thread and never delete it.
public_comment_rules.source: Reply Library RL-11, RL-12, RL-16, RL-18.

sla.status_note: These targets are proposed by the audit. Dental Hub has no documented SLA and no evidence of one was found. They are NOT commitments and must never be stated to a customer.

reviewer_must_confirm: No price, discount, instalment term or warranty duration appears in the text unless it came from an approved knowledge entry.
No delivery date or response-time commitment appears in the text.
No exclusivity or best-selling claim appears in the text.
The reply answers the question that was actually asked.
handoff_contract.delivery: The reviewer copies the approved text and sends it themselves from Meta Inbox. This system has no send capability.

qualification.collection_rule: Ask at most one qualifying question per message, and only after the customer's own question has been answered or acknowledged.
qualification.capture_note: CAPTURE_FIELD is DENY in the authority matrix. These fields describe what a human reviewer should try to establish, not what the system may store.
qualification.source: Reply Library RL-02, RL-08, RL-16; Taxonomy & Lists columns F, G, H.

data_collection.public_surface_rule: No personal data may be requested or restated on a public comment thread, ever.

products.note: Existence only. No price, no warranty, no availability and no superlative claim is asserted here — those live as DRAFT knowledge until Dental Hub confirms them in writing.

known_at_publication: No approved price for any product.
No confirmed instalment terms: number of months, down payment, financing partner.
No confirmed warranty duration or coverage.
No confirmed delivery coverage, delivery times or installation/training terms.
No confirmed expiry date for the Fomos Autoclave discount seen in Ad Library, so it cannot be approved as an OFFER.
No confirmed named owner per queue.
knowledge_gaps.note: Every item here is a question the system will hand to a human until Dental Hub answers it. That is the designed behaviour, not a defect.

limitations: No conversation was ever opened. The audit was read-only by rule, so there is no message-based finding in the workbook at all and every Messages Log / Lead Pipeline / SLA §B figure is an empty-range formula meaning 'not measured', never 'zero occurred'.
The 5 fully-recorded posts are all Reels published between 15 and 24 August 2026. Any statement about photos or carousels in the source workbook is inferential.
The 6 comments came from the 'needs attention' To-do list, not from the 3,939 comments Insights reports. The 100% unanswered rate has a denominator of 6 and must never be generalised.
Every previous-period figure in Monthly Summary is back-calculated from a percentage change; Meta never displayed those absolute values.
Content Score, Hook Strength, Offer Clarity, CTA Clarity and Purchase-Intent labels are reviewer judgement at n=5 and n=6.
Total posts in the 90-day window is unknown, so no coverage ratio may be reported.

section_rationale.escalation: insufficient_knowledge_action is REQUEST_HUMAN_HANDOFF rather than ASK_CLARIFICATION: with almost no approved commercial knowledge, a clarifying question would stall the customer instead of reaching someone who can answer.
